data.one_liner: Checks whether the app is running in the iOS Simulator or on a physical device
data.what_it_does: Checks whether the current application is running inside the iOS Simulator or on a physical device. Returns false on non-iOS platforms and uses conditional imports to avoid breaking web builds.
use_when: You need to detect if your app is running in the iOS simulator
You want to avoid heavy transitive dependencies introduced by larger device info packages
avoid_when: You need comprehensive device information beyond just iOS simulator detection
strengths: Safe for web builds via conditional imports
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific check (iOS simulator vs physical device)
data.setup_notes: No special native configuration or setup required.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need broader device info and system details across multiple platforms rather than just iOS simulator detection.
